response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong engineering fundamentals with 15+ years of experience, polyglot programming (TypeScript, D, C++, Java, Node.js), and a track record in scalable systems (e.g., micro-services at Dunnhumby). However, his resume lacks direct evidence of experimentation systems, feature-flagging, or growth/measurement platform experience. His recent AI-agent infrastructure work is tangential but not aligned with experimentation frameworks. Leadership and stakeholder alignment are implied but not explicitly detailed.
strengths: Proven expertise in scalable, low-latency systems (e.g., micro-services at Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong polyglot programming skills with deep experience in multiple languages (D, C++, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript)
Demonstrated technical leadership through mentorship, workshops, and open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
concerns: No explicit experience with experimentation platforms, feature-flagging, or growth systems (key requirement for this role)
Limited evidence of work with AI tools to accelerate engineering velocity or experimentation quality
Resume lacks clear examples of translating ambiguous business problems into measurable engineering outcomes for growth/measurement systems
